note: Places on the overworld outside the town circles (build_overworld.py): abbeys, castles, the drowned land, the heath. Positions WGS84; 'uncertain': true where the position or the 1650 state was not verified. The Scheldt forts come from politics.json 'points'. 'seaSeed' is a point in the North Sea from which the OSM coastline is flood-filled; 'includeInOverworld' are points the overworld bounds must contain.

marshAreas.name: Verdronken Land van Saeftinghe
marshAreas.y1650: The Land van Saeftinghe was flooded in 1584, when the States' troops cut the dikes to stop the Spanish advance on Antwerp; the villages in it were lost and in 1650 it was tidal flats and salt marsh (schorren en slikken) on the south bank of the Westerschelde, in States hands. The outline here is today's nature reserve widened over polders reclaimed later (Prosperpolder 1840s, Hertogin Hedwigepolder 1907); the 1650 edge is NOT verified.
marshAreas.source: nl.wikipedia 'Verdronken Land van Saeftinghe'; extent approximate

sites.name: Saeftinghe (verdronken dorp)
sites.y1650: Site of the drowned village of Saeftinghe (lost after 1584); in legend its bells still ring under the water. Exact site not verified; other villages of the land (Namen, Casuele and others) were lost too - names and sites not verified.
sites.source: nl.wikipedia 'Verdronken Land van Saeftinghe' (not re-checked for the village sites)

sites.name: Abdij van Herkenrode
sites.y1650: Rich Cistercian nunnery near Kuringen, owner of the Hasselt tithes and a refuge in Hasselt (inventory 140049).

sites.name: Landcommanderij Alden Biesen
sites.y1650: Seat of the bailiwick of the Teutonic Order (Biesen) near Rijkhoven, rebuilt in the 16th-17th c.

sites.name: Abdij van Averbode
sites.y1650: Norbertine abbey north of Scherpenheuvel (refuge house in Diest).

sites.name: Abdij van Tongerlo
sites.y1650: Norbertine abbey in the Kempen (refuge house 'Het Spijker' in Diest).

sites.name: Abdij van Affligem
sites.y1650: Benedictine abbey between Brussels and Aalst.

sites.name: Heide tussen Hasselt en Maaseik
sites.y1650: The Kempen heath of Loon (Genk, As, Opglabbeek): open heath and sand with few villages, drawn as 'bruyère' on Ferraris (land cover class heath). The road Hasselt-Maaseik crosses it.

sites.name: Grens Brabant - Loon
sites.y1650: The border between the duchy of Brabant and the county of Loon (prince-bishopric of Liège) ran a few km east of Diest, between Diest and Halen/Lummen; Halen itself was Brabant. Exact line not traced (see politics.json).
